text.19_Daf, 2_Comment: 3. Along the path a person wishes to proceed, one leads and assists him etc. - See the Commentators on this and I will also give my perspective. It does not say that Holy One Blessed Be He leads the person rather he is led. And this is based on what is written in many places that all thoughts, speech, and actions of a person create a Malach according to the matter, both for good and for bad. Therefore, it says in the way a person wants to go, which is given over to man from the Blessed Be He (i.e. free choice), for all is in the hands of Heaven except for Fear of Heaven. But according to his will, and his understanding of a person he goes, those Malachim are created from that will or thought in him. And the Amora bring a proof from the Torah, as it says "You shall not go with them." Yet the Holy One Blessed Be him says and it written "Arise, go with them." That is his will (Balaam) and bad intention to go with them came a Malach like his will and though that said to him "Arise, go with them." And it says that it is written "I am Hashem Your God" - who teachs for your benefit etc., for all Mitzvos of the Blessed Be He is only to teach for ones benefits and that it s good for you. But your guide is the Malach that you send and you go according to your understanding and will. And it says that it is written "if to the scoffers, he will be a scoffer" etc. In other words, if to the scoffers, he will add to him scoffing that is a Malach to scoff, and if for humbleness he will give him a Malach of grace before him, Blessed be He.
